whatIs: Logoipsum is a collection of more than 200 placeholder logos that you download as SVG and PNG. They work like lorem ipsum for brands: believable logos to fill mockups, prototypes and templates until the client's real logo arrives.
It's a good fit when you need an interface to look finished without inventing brands or using real companies' logos.
uses: Filling the clients or partners section of a landing page in development.
Giving a Figma mockup a visual identity during a demo.
Populating a template or a theme with a sample brand.
caveats: Unmodified logos are only good as placeholders: they can't be used as a brand's final identity or registered as a trademark.
You can't resell the logos as they are or bundle them to offer a competing service.
The editor's premium fonts are sold as add-ons (Editor+), and their license covers a single commercial project.
pricingNote: The logos are free, including in commercial projects and without attribution; extra fonts, extended licenses and the Pro plugin are paid.
idealFor: Mockups and prototypes that need placeholder logos.
